sloka: भयाद्यस्योपतिष्ठेतां निष्पन्दौ सागरानिलौ ।सो ऽयं मृधे त्वया बद्धः पौत्रो मे रणदुर्जयः ।। ७.३३.१५ ॥
transliteration: bhayādyasyopatiṣṭhetāṁ niṣpandau sāgarānilau ।so 'yaṁ mṛdhe tvayā baddhaḥ pautro me raṇadurjayaḥ ।। 7.33.15 ॥

translations.english: That grandson of mine, who is unconquerable in battle and from fear of whom the ocean and the wind stand motionless, has been bound by you in combat.
